# xHamster

> Free adult video streaming platform for browsing, searching, and filtering millions of porn videos, categories, and creator uploads.

xHamster is a large adult tube site focused on video discovery through category pages, newest and trending feeds, rankings, search, and long-form browsing. The site emphasizes free streaming, extensive taxonomy, and multiple content feeds for finding videos by niche, popularity, duration, and recency.

## Core Discovery
- [Home](https://xhamster.com/): Main video feed featuring trending and recommended adult videos.
- [Newest](https://xhamster.com/newest): Chronological feed of the latest uploaded porn videos.
- [Categories](https://xhamster.com/categories): Directory of porn categories and sex niches across the site.
- [Search](https://xhamster.com/search): Search entry point for finding videos by keyword.
- [Best This Week](https://xhamster.com/best/weekly): Weekly ranking of top-performing videos on the platform.
- [Best This Month](https://xhamster.com/best/monthly): Monthly leaderboard of popular adult videos.
- [Best All Time](https://xhamster.com/best): Overall top-ranked videos based on site engagement.

## Video Formats and Length
- [Full-Length](https://xhamster.com/full-length): Collection of longer-form porn videos and movies.
- [Newest Full-Length](https://xhamster.com/full-length/newest): Latest uploads within the full-length video section.
- [HD Videos](https://xhamster.com/hd): Feed focused on high-definition adult videos.
- [4K Videos](https://xhamster.com/4k): Collection of ultra-high-resolution 4K porn videos.
- [VR Videos](https://xhamster.com/vr): Virtual reality adult videos for immersive viewing.

## Rankings and Recommendations
- [Latest Recommendations](https://xhamster.com/latest-recommendations): Personalized recommendation feed based on recent viewing signals.

- [Best Monthly](https://xhamster.com/best/monthly): Monthly roundup of top adult video content.
